label: digit 0 input late in the original phase of w-initial sequences containing h/d/x
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.007% of steps). 96% of activation mass is in the original phase at positions 4-8 (peak t=5-6), and 76% of mass falls on input token 0. Activation depends strongly on the earlier prefix: first token w (17.9x lift, 67% of mass) and earlier h/d/x inputs (prev_tok/prev2_tok lifts 5-8x). The top example (3.83) is w r h d x 0. Never fires in the copy phase, never at t<4, and only weakly on <DEL> (4% of mass). Inputs other than 0 (e.g. w, j, q, z) occasionally fire weakly in the same contexts. Precision is low: most 0 inputs at t>=4 do not fire (0.7% precision), and even with the w-first and h/d/x-seen conditions only ~21% of predicted steps fire, so the exact prefix combination that drives it is not captured. Magnitude is largest when 0 follows a w...h/d/x prefix.
